VI.description: Moves Claude by one tick. Ground: walk, conveyor push, jump, step onto a ladder or rope, fall off an edge, grab a pole over its hole. Air: gravity, head bump, landing on walls, thin floors (only from above) and ladder tops, grabbing a ladder (with Up/Down), a rope or a pole while falling. Ladder/rope: climb, stop at the top, floor or ceiling, step off sideways, jump off. Pole: slide down. A vanishing floor carries only while FloorPhase < 2. Dead = landed more than the allowed height below the last firm stand. Positions are tenths of a pixel.
